rule.tier1: a case helps if, per lot, it beats its base (UNION or UNION_ADX, see base_of) in 2025 AND in 2026, is not worse in at least 3 of the 4 half-years (2025 Jan-Jun / Jul-Dec, 2026 Jan-May / Jun-Oct) and makes at least 40 trades in each year; the day-type gates are also shown against UNION_ADX
rule.luck: the dmi case on the 20 random-entry books: median change per year; a direction case that lifts random entries as much is a market-direction effect, reported as such
rule.status: both years are seen (2026 in-sample, 2025 since O30); a passing case is a candidate for the unseen checks (SENSEX Jan - Aug 2026 once downloaded, the forward panel), never a go-live on this replay
rule.tier2: patterns the investigation finds afterwards are reported as found-by-looking, not scored as proof
rule.no_change: nothing in the system changes on this result; the owner decides
